name: (01) Mortis (Cadaverous Animation) — 1 Basic — Trace of Life

system.description: You can simulate dead flesh so it appears to twitch or move slowly, thus simulating the effects of life or horrifying mortal onlookers. Perform a Mental Challenge. Unless you fail, you can make the corpse move slightly, appear to breathe, twitch, or even open its eyes. If the corpse is more than a handful of minutes dead, it is unlikely the lifeless orbs will do more than scare witnesses. You can also use this power on torpid Cainites of higher or equal generation, but you must bid two extra Traits in the challenge.
